entries.text: Nothing to exclude yet — uncheck a value to exclude it, or select values first.
entries.translation: 暂无排除项。取消勾选某个值可将其排除，也可以先选择一些值。

entries.text: Approximate count over the active column filters and time range only. It excludes full-text search, score, and comment filters, so it can be noticeably higher than the number of matching rows.
entries.translation: 此估算总数只考虑当前列筛选和时间范围，不包含全文搜索、评分或评论筛选，因此可能明显高于实际匹配行数。

entries.text: Approximate number of matching rows for the active filters and time range, estimated with ClickHouse's HyperLogLog (typically within a few percent of the true count).
entries.translation: 根据当前筛选和时间范围，使用 ClickHouse 的 HyperLogLog 估算匹配行数；通常与实际数量相差几个百分点。
关于网关密钥附加信息

entries.text: Attached to every trace from this key, so you can filter and group by it.
entries.translation: 这些信息会附加到使用此密钥上报的每条完整执行记录，便于筛选和分组。

entries.text: Link to the source trace, observation or session based on which this item was added
entries.translation: 打开此条目对应的原始完整执行、执行步骤或对话。

entries.text: Score configs define the fields annotators see. Adding or removing fields applies when items are reopened, including completed items. Historical scores and completion status stay unchanged. Editing a score config changes its project-wide definition for future scoring wherever it is used.
entries.translation: 评分配置决定标注人员看到的字段。添加或移除字段会在重新打开条目时生效，也包括已完成的条目；历史评分和完成状态保持。编辑配置会改变项目级定义，影响之后所有使用此配置的评分。

entries.text: Calculated multiplying the number of tokens with cost per token for each model.
entries.translation: 按各模型的 Token 数量乘以对应单价计算。

entries.text: Link to the source trace based on which this item was added
entries.translation: 打开添加此条目时对应的原始完整执行。

entries.text: When a single csv column is mapped to a dataset item field, wrap its value in an object instead of using the raw value. Example:
entries.translation: 将单个 CSV 列对应到数据集条目字段时，把值包装为对象，而非直接使用原值。例如：

entries.text: The evaluator has been used in the past but is currently paused. It will not run against outputs created in this dataset run. You can reactivate it if you wish
entries.translation: 此评估器曾使用过，目前已暂停，不会评估本次数据集运行的输出。需要时可重新启用。

entries.text: Variable in the template to be replaced with the mapped data.
entries.translation: 模板中的变量，会被对应的数据替换。

entries.text: One label per option. A short description sharpens the boundary between options; add an “other” option when the list may not cover every input.
entries.translation: 每个选项对应一个标签。简短说明有助于区分各选项；若列表无法覆盖全部输入，可增加“其他”选项。

entries.text: Choice picks one of a fixed set of labels. Score rates along ordered levels you describe. Yes/no returns the probability that a statement is true. Pick the one your code can act on directly.
entries.translation: “选择”从固定标签中选一个；“评分”按你描述的有序等级评价；“是非”返回某个陈述为真的概率。请选择代码能直接使用的结果类型。

entries.text: Each question writes its own score under this name. Keep it stable: renaming starts a new score series.
entries.translation: 每个问题都会以此名称保存独立评分。建议保持名称稳定；改名会开始一个新的评分序列。

entries.text: Each question is one snap judgment about the state and writes one score. All questions are answered in a single model call, so a second or tenth question costs only its own tokens.
entries.translation: 每个问题都对当前状态作一次快速判断，并保存一个评分。所有问题在同一次模型调用中回答，增加问题只会增加其自身的 Token 用量。

entries.text: Answered together in one call; extra questions add only their own tokens.
entries.translation: 附加问题在同一次调用中一起回答，只增加其自身的 Token 用量。

entries.text: Ask for one snap judgment. This text is sent as written. The model reads the input object, so the question does not insert fields.
entries.translation: 只要求一次快速判断。此问题会按原文发送；模型会读取输入对象，问题中无需插入字段值。

entries.text: Ask for one snap judgment a knowledgeable person makes in a second. Name the state field the question is about in backticks, for example “Does `question` request a refund?”. The model reads the state as a JSON object, so the question does not repeat the data.
entries.translation: 提出一个有相关知识的人能迅速判断的问题，用反引号标明所指字段，例如“`question` 是否要求退款？”。模型会读取 JSON 状态对象，问题中无需重复数据。

entries.text: Each level is one point on the scale. The model judges every level on its own against the state and returns a position between them, so describe situations (“broken, but a workaround exists”), not degrees (“moderately severe”). Two to ten levels; drag to reorder.
entries.translation: 每个等级是量表上的一个位置。模型会分别对照当前状态判断，再返回介于等级之间的分值。因此请描述具体情况（如“功能损坏，但有替代办法”），而非模糊程度（如“中等严重”）。支持 2 至 10 个等级，可拖动排序。

entries.text: The score is the probability-weighted average of the level numbers, so it can be a decimal from 0 to
entries.translation: 评分是各等级编号按概率加权的平均值，因此可以是小数，范围从 0 到

entries.text: Use custom code for deterministic checks like exact matches, regex, or schema validation. Use an LLM when the check needs judgment, such as rating helpfulness, tone, or answer quality. Use a decision model for a fast, cheap label with calibrated probabilities when the possible answers are known upfront.
entries.translation: 完全匹配、正则表达式或格式校验等确定性检查适合用代码；有用性、语气、回答质量等需要判断的检查适合用大模型。若候选答案预先确定，可用判断模型快速、低成本地给出标签和校准后的概率。

entries.text: The evaluator name is also used as the score name for the scores it produces.
entries.translation: 评估器名称也会用作其生成的评分名称。

entries.text: Add metadata to traces to track additional information.
entries.translation: 为完整执行添加附加信息，以记录其他内容。

entries.text: You can differentiate the importance of observations with the level attribute to control the verbosity of your traces and highlight errors and warnings.
entries.translation: 状态（level）表示执行步骤的重要程度，可区分常规、警告和错误，便于筛选记录和定位问题。

entries.text: Use a statusMessage to e.g. provide additional information on a status such as level=ERROR.
entries.translation: 状态说明（statusMessage）用于补充详细情况，例如说明 level=ERROR 的具体原因。

entries.text: Link to prompt version in Langfuse prompt management.
entries.translation: 打开提示词管理中对应的提示词版本。

entries.text: Track changes via the version tag.
entries.translation: 通过版本标签追踪变化。

entries.text: Track changes to your application via the release tag.
entries.translation: 通过发布版本标签追踪应用的变化。

entries.text: Runs on another dataset scored different items, so their values are not comparable.
entries.translation: 不同数据集上的运行评估了不同条目，因此评分不能直接比较。

entries.text: This run name is auto-generated from the experiment name and can be used to fetch the resulting experiment run via the public API.
entries.translation: 此运行名称根据实验名称自动生成，可用来通过公共 API 获取对应的实验运行结果。

entries.text: Average duration of the root span per experiment item.
entries.translation: 每个实验条目中，顶层步骤的平均耗时。

entries.text: Save the integration before running the validation.
entries.translation: 请先保存集成配置，再验证。

entries.text: You can use this prompt within your application through the Langfuse SDKs and integrations. Refer to the documentation for more information.
entries.translation: 可通过 Langfuse SDK 和集成，在应用中使用此提示词。详细用法请参阅文档。

entries.text: This is calculated based on the selected date range, not the full usage history.
entries.translation: 此值根据当前选择的日期范围计算，并非全部历史用量。

entries.text: Add metadata to scores to track additional information.
entries.translation: 为评分添加附加信息，以记录其他内容。

entries.text: The user ID associated with the trace.
entries.translation: 与完整执行关联的用户 ID。

entries.text: Categorical and text scores have no numeric value, so they're excluded from Value.
entries.translation: 分类评分和文本评分没有数值，因此不计入“数值”列。

entries.text: Some messages may be missing because the observation limit was reached.
entries.translation: 已达到执行步骤数量上限，可能有部分消息未显示。

entries.text: The number of traces in the session.
entries.translation: 此对话中的完整执行次数。

entries.text: Private channels are only listed for the person who connected Slack to this project, and only those they are a member of. Reconnect Slack to list your own private channels.
entries.translation: 只有将 Slack 连接到此项目的人能看到其已加入的私有频道。如需查看自己的私有频道，请重新连接 Slack。

entries.text: The number of observations in the trace.
entries.translation: 此完整执行中的执行步骤数量。

entries.text: The unique identifier for the user that was logged in Langfuse. See docs for more details on how to set this up.
entries.translation: 记录在 Langfuse 中的用户唯一标识。配置方式请参阅文档。

entries.text: The earliest trace recorded for this user.
entries.translation: 该用户最早的一条完整执行记录。

entries.text: The latest trace recorded for this user.
entries.translation: 该用户最近的一条完整执行记录。

entries.text: Total number of events for the user, includes traces and observations. See data model for more details.
entries.translation: 该用户的事件总数，包括完整执行和执行步骤。详见数据模型。

entries.text: Total number of tokens used for the user across all generations.
entries.translation: 该用户全部模型调用的 Token 总用量。

entries.text: Total cost for the user across all generations.
entries.translation: 该用户全部模型调用的总费用。
